tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Turquoise (sepia: walnut). Tappable crumbs in breadcrumbs, section labels in the settings sheet, the pin mark, a saved bookmark heart, TextButton labels, "AI-generated" note. 6.3:1+ on surface in every theme.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill: Switch thumb when on, filled Button labels.

tokens.name: primary-container
tokens.usage: Tonal turquoise fill for emphasised containers (Material defaults: filled-tonal surfaces). Rarely used directly.

tokens.name: on-primary-container
tokens.usage: Text on primary-container.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Saffron accent (sepia: olive-brown). The tilework counterpart to primary; reserve for accents, never body text.

tokens.name: on-secondary
tokens.usage: Text on a secondary fill.

tokens.name: secondary-container
tokens.usage: Peach fill: a selected FilterChip, and the disc behind a poet portrait (shows the initial when no portrait exists).

tokens.name: on-secondary-container
tokens.usage: Text and check-mark on secondary-container: selected chip label, poet initial. 7.2:1+ in every theme.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Window and splash background (res/values/colors.xml window_background mirrors light and dark).

tokens.name: on-background
tokens.usage: Text on background.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground behind lists, the reader column, top app bar and sheets.

tokens.name: on-surface
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface: poem verses, list headlines, the current breadcrumb. 10.6:1+ in every theme.

tokens.name: surface-variant
tokens.usage: Muted fill for variant surfaces (Material defaults: slider inactive track, chip disabled).

tokens.name: on-surface-variant
tokens.usage: Secondary text and icons: metre line, couplet summaries, setting notes, "»" separators, action icons. 5.6:1+ on surface and surface-container-highest in every theme.

tokens.name: surface-bright
tokens.usage: Brightest surface tone; OLED keeps it 46% of the way to black.

tokens.name: surface-dim
tokens.usage: Dimmest surface tone.

tokens.name: surface-container-lowest
tokens.usage: Lowest container tone.

tokens.name: surface-container-low
tokens.usage: Bottom sheet and elevated card ground (Material default for ModalBottomSheet).

tokens.name: surface-container
tokens.usage: Default container tone: navigation bar, menus.

tokens.name: surface-container-high
tokens.usage: Dialogs and dropdown menus.

tokens.name: surface-container-highest
tokens.usage: Filled Card ground: poet cards in the grid; Switch track when off.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: 1px borders: OutlinedTextField, unselected FilterChip outline in focus, Switch border when off. Sepia is 3.3:1 on surface, still above the 3:1 floor for control borders.

tokens.name: outline-variant
tokens.usage: Material 3 default, not overridden by any scheme (a faintly purple grey): HorizontalDivider and the unselected FilterChip border. Decorative only; never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Material 3 default, not overridden. Load-failure and assistant error text on surface.

tokens.name: on-error
tokens.usage: Material 3 default. Text on an error fill.

tokens.name: downloaded
tokens.usage: ColorScheme.downloaded in Theme.kt: the CheckCircle beside a poet already saved on the device. Picked by surface luminance (<0.5 → light green). Always paired with the tick shape, never colour alone. 4.1:1+ on surface in every theme.

tokens.name: surface-tonal-3
tokens.usage: Derived, not declared: Material 3 tonal elevation 3dp (primary at 8.2% over surface). The bottom search bar's Surface on the poets screen.

styles.name: poem-naskh
styles.sample: الا یا ایها الساقی ادر کأسا و ناولها
styles.usage: The poem itself, default font. Size 14–40px in 2px steps (default 22); weight Regular / Medium / Semibold / Bold chosen by the reader; leading always 1.8× the size.

styles.name: poem-nastaliq
styles.sample: الا یا ایها الساقی ادر کأسا و ناولها
styles.usage: The poem when the reader picks nastaliq. Leading 2.4× — nastaliq stacks diagonally and has deep descenders, so tighter leading clips the swashes. Same size and weight range as naskh.

spacing.note: Compose dp values as written in the screens; 1dp = 1px here.

tokens.usage: Vertical padding around each couplet.

tokens.name: space-8

tokens.name: space-12

tokens.name: space-16

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Reader column side padding; settings sheet side padding.
